title: persona-grpc/build.rs emits no rerun-if-changed, so proto edits do not regenerate code
description:
persona-grpc/build.rs compiles ../proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto but never emits a cargo:rerun-if-changed directive.

Cargo's default when a build script emits no rerun-if-changed is to rerun it when any file *inside the package* changes. The proto lives at the workspace root (proto/), outside persona-grpc/, so it is not in that set. Editing workload.proto and rebuilding silently reuses the previously generated code — the build succeeds against a stale API and the mismatch only surfaces later as a confusing type error or a wire-format bug.

Add:
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=../proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto");
(and one for the include dir if more protos are added).
